an7.44:1.1: 'pare dve ti. XLI. Satt' imā bhikkhave viññāṇaṭṭhitiyo. Katamā satta? Santi bhikkhave sattā nānattakāyā nānattasaññino, seyyathā pi manussā ekacce ca devā ekacce ca vinipātikā. Ayaṃ paṭhamā viññāṇaṭṭhiti.
an7.44:2.1: Santi bhikkhave sattā nānattakāyā ekattasaññino, seyyathā pi devā {Brahmakāyikā} paṭhamābhinibbattā. Ayaṃ dutiyā viññāṇaṭṭhiti.
an7.44:3.1: Santi bhikkhave sattā ekattakāyā nānattasaññino, seyyathā pi devā {Ābhassarā}. Ayaṃ tatiyā viññāṇaṭṭhiti.
an7.44:4.1: Santi bhikkhave sattā ekattakāyā ekattasaññino, seyyathā pi devā {Subhakiṇhā}. Ayaṃ catutthā viññāṇaṭṭhiti.
an7.44:5.1: Santi bhikkhave sattā sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamma paṭighasaññānaṃ atthaṅgamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā ‘ananto ākāso' ti ākāsānañcāyatanūpagā. Ayaṃ pañcamā viññāṇaṭṭhiti.
an7.44:6.1: Santi bhikkhave sattā sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma ‘anantaṃ viññāṇan' ti viññāṇañcāyatanūpagā. Ayaṃ chaṭṭhā viññāṇaṭṭhiti.
an7.44:7.1: Santi bhikkhave sattā sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma ‘natthi kiñcī' ti ākiñcaññāyatanūpagā. Ayaṃ sattamā viññāṇaṭṭhiti.
an7.44:8.1: Imā kho bhikkhave satta viññāṇaṭṭhitiyo ti.
